crew.overview: John Anderton is a top 'Precrime' cop in the late-21st century, when technology can predict crimes before they're committed. But Anderton becomes the quarry when another investigator targets him for a murder charge.
crew.title: Minority Report

details.biography: Debi Young is an award winning Makeup Artist & Designer with 4 Emmy Noms! MARE OF EASTTOWN, MA RAINEY’s, WATCHMEN, TRUE DETECTIVE, THE WIZ LIVE, BESSIE, THE WIRE. She is a 2024 Winner for a NAACP Image Award for Outstanding Makeup (Television or Film)
details.name: Debi Young
